title: Amtrak's completed station-design inventory progresses from 260 to 302
summary: The biannual reports list 260 completed station designs in October 2024, 273 in April 2025, 287 in October 2025, and 302 in April 2026. Denominator: Four compatible completed-design inventory observations, kept distinct from procurement, construction, turnover, final acceptance, operating availability, and use.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Compatible service time series.
